entries.5ef267d9874674de: A business conducted by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Life Assist Co., Ltd. Through 108 directly operated stores (as of end-June 2026) of the walk-in insurance shop "Hoken Clinic", it sells insurance through consulting that uses the insurance analysis and search system "Hoken IQ System"; for the 199 franchise (FC) stores nationwide, it provides the system, education and training, and support for store operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,817 million.

The number of IDs as of end-June 2026 was 7,782 for insurance agencies and banks. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,378 million.

entries.840c3bfaf3f29d45: The company sells insurance through consulting at its directly operated and FC stores of the walk-in insurance shop "Hoken Clinic", using the insurance analysis and search system "Hoken IQ System." It also offers insurance proposals for corporations and high-net-worth individuals, provides the "AS Series" to agencies and financial institutions, and develops and sells AI products.
entries.86e5fc5e3a53520b: As its corporate philosophy, the company upholds "Coexistence of Triple Benefits" for customers, insurance companies and agencies. Its three-year plan, starting with the fiscal year ended June 2026 as the first year, takes the simultaneous achievement of further growth and capital efficiency as its basic policy. It aims to further improve the number of walk-in insurance shops under the Insurance Clinic brand, the number of contracts concluded and customer satisfaction, and to advance product development to establish the AS Series as a vertical SaaS specialized in the insurance industry.

entries.9a7f82eb9175777f: Its distinctive features include the in-house developed 'Hoken IQ System', which handles everything from securities analysis to product search, comparison proposals and application procedures in a single system, reflects insurance data accumulated as an insurance agency and feedback from sales staff in its development, and has API links with the systems of 16 insurance companies. Its 'Smart OCR', which handles non-standard forms, also has a distinctive background in having started with the digitization of insurance policies.

entries.a7e504d0869d57bc: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥10,964 million. Revenue was ¥5,817 million for the Insurance Clinic Business, ¥2,275 million for the FA Business, ¥1,378 million for the Solution Business and ¥1,492 million for the System Business.
entries.adab472c06588431: The Management Policies, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed section states that the Hoken IQ System is an insurance one-stop sales system that handles everything from securities analysis, life plan creation, product selection and comparison proposals to application procedures; that it has competitive advantages based on securities analysis using insurance data accumulated as an insurance agency, operability reflecting the opinions of insurance solicitors in the field, and API linkage with the systems of 16 insurance companies; and that Smart OCR has a competitive advantage as non-standard form OCR because it started as a service that digitizes insurance policies, which are non-standard documents.
